subject.title: fix(talk): reject malformed relay audio base64

question: Should `talk.session.appendAudio` preserve the currently accepted RFC 4648 URL-safe alphabet, or intentionally become standard-base64-only?
rationale: Current runtime behavior accepts both alphabets and the public protocol only says base64, so automation cannot safely choose a breaking wire-contract interpretation.

options.title: Preserve both alphabets
options.body: Validate round-trip canonical bytes while accepting standard and URL-safe base64, rejecting only malformed or oversized frames.

options.title: Adopt standard-only
options.body: Approve the narrower protocol explicitly, update protocol documentation and supported clients, and provide upgrade and configured-provider proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve both alphabets
recommendation.body: Validate round-trip canonical bytes while accepting standard and URL-safe base64, rejecting only malformed or oversized frames.

likelyOwner.reason: The central Talk gateway-session and relay history points to this person as the strongest available owner for the wire-contract choice.
